From: RC01 build maintainers
Subject: [PATCH] RC01: reap dae before runtime cleanup and keep source updates

Based on kenzok8/openwrt-daede 3520a79bd9c68843801dc89d7d6e155d2c43c833.
The guard's signal/reap ordering follows that project's daed-guard.
Retain upstream copyright, licenses, and source provenance.

diff --git a/dae/files/dae-guard b/dae/files/dae-guard
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ee6af8f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dae/files/dae-guard
@@ -0,0 +1,109 @@
+#!/bin/sh
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
+# RC01 lifecycle guard. Signal/reap ordering follows kenzok8/openwrt-daede's
+# daed-guard at 1eedcafd1cd4d8a89ac928be6608df76ffb38f78.
+# dae owns TC/BPF detach. Never remove shared BPF pins or unrelated links.
+
+dae_guard_cleanup() {
+	local rc namespaces links pid pids
+	# Refuse a second proxy instance or cleanup while another core is alive.
+	pidof dae daed mihomo >/dev/null 2>&1
+	rc=$?
+	case "$rc" in
+		0) logger -t dae-init 'another proxy is running; leaving runtime state untouched'; return 1 ;;
+		1) ;;
+		*) logger -t dae-init 'cannot verify proxy processes; refusing cleanup'; return 1 ;;
+	esac
+	namespaces=$(ip netns list) || return 1
+	links=$(ip -o link show) || return 1
+	if printf '%s\n' "$namespaces" | grep -Eq '^daens([[:space:]]|$)'; then
+		# No userspace core is alive. Only reap the reserved dae namespace.
+		pids=$(ip netns pids daens) || return 1
+		for pid in $pids; do
+			case "$pid" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0|1) return 1 ;; esac
+			kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
+		done
+		pids=$(ip netns pids daens) || return 1
+		if [ -n "$pids" ]; then
+			sleep 1
+			pids=$(ip netns pids daens) || return 1
+			for pid in $pids; do
+				case "$pid" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0|1) return 1 ;; esac
+				kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
+			done
+		fi
+		ip netns del daens || return 1
+	fi
+	if printf '%s\n' "$links" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+: dae0(@[^:]+)?:'; then
+		ip link del dae0 || return 1
+	fi
+}
+
+dae_guard_main() {
+	dae_guard_cleanup || return 1
+	child_pid=
+	pending_signal=
+	shutdown_signal=
+	shutdown_elapsed=0
+	forced_kill=0
+	child_term_timeout=20
+
+	forward_signal() {
+		local sig="$1"
+		if [ -z "$child_pid" ]; then
+			pending_signal="$sig"
+			return
+		fi
+		case "$sig" in
+			TERM|INT|QUIT)
+				if [ -z "$shutdown_signal" ]; then
+					shutdown_signal="$sig"
+					shutdown_elapsed=0
+				fi ;;
+		esac
+		kill -"$sig" "$child_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
+	}
+	child_is_running() {
+		local state
+		kill -0 "$child_pid" 2>/dev/null || return 1
+		state=$(awk '{ print $3 }' "/proc/$child_pid/stat" 2>/dev/null)
+		[ "$state" != Z ]
+	}
+	trap 'forward_signal TERM' TERM
+	trap 'forward_signal INT' INT
+	trap 'forward_signal HUP' HUP
+	trap 'forward_signal QUIT' QUIT
+	if [ -n "$pending_signal" ]; then
+		trap - TERM INT HUP QUIT
+		return 1
+	fi
+	"${DAE_GUARD_PROGRAM:-/usr/bin/dae}" "$@" &
+	child_pid=$!
+	if [ -n "$pending_signal" ]; then
+		forward_signal "$pending_signal"
+	fi
+	local status=0 cleanup_status=0
+	while :; do
+		if [ -n "$shutdown_signal" ] && child_is_running; then
+			if [ "$shutdown_elapsed" -ge "$child_term_timeout" ] && [ "$forced_kill" -eq 0 ]; then
+				logger -t dae-init 'core did not exit within 20s; killing it; TC/BPF state needs inspection'
+				kill -KILL "$child_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
+				forced_kill=1
+			fi
+			sleep 1
+			shutdown_elapsed=$((shutdown_elapsed + 1))
+			continue
+		fi
+		wait "$child_pid" 2>/dev/null
+		status=$?
+		child_is_running || break
+	done
+	child_pid=
+	trap - TERM INT HUP QUIT
+	# Cleanup happens only after wait has reaped the core, before procd respawn.
+	dae_guard_cleanup || cleanup_status=$?
+	[ "$status" -eq 0 ] || return "$status"
+	return "$cleanup_status"
+}
+
+[ "${DAE_GUARD_LIBRARY:-0}" = 1 ] || dae_guard_main "$@"
diff --git a/dae/files/dae.init b/dae/files/dae.init
index 394897e..44d179d 100644
--- a/dae/files/dae.init
+++ b/dae/files/dae.init
@@ -28,7 +28,7 @@ start_service() {
 
 	procd_open_instance "$CONF"
 	procd_set_param env DAE_LOCATION_ASSET="/usr/share/v2ray" TZ="$(uci -q get system.@system[0].zonename)"
-	procd_set_param command "$PROG" run
+	procd_set_param command /usr/bin/dae-guard run
 	procd_append_param command --config "$config_file"
 	procd_append_param command --logfile "$LOG_DIR/dae.log"
 	procd_append_param command --logfile-maxbackups "$log_maxbackups"
@@ -36,28 +36,17 @@ start_service() {
 
 	procd_set_param limits core="unlimited"
 	procd_set_param limits nofile="1000000 1000000"
-	procd_set_param respawn
+	procd_set_param term_timeout 30
+	procd_set_param respawn 3600 5 5
 	# procd_set_param stdout 1
 	procd_set_param stderr 1
 
 	procd_close_instance
 }
 
+# procd terminates the guard; it forwards TERM and waits before cleanup.
 stop_service() {
-	rm -rf "$LOG_DIR"
-	# kill lingering procs in daens: TERM first, then KILL for stubborn ones
-	for pid in $(ip netns pids daens 2>/dev/null); do kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null; done
-	if [ -n "$(ip netns pids daens 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
-		sleep 1
-		for pid in $(ip netns pids daens 2>/dev/null); do kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; done
-	fi
-	# cleanup daens netns; ip-full needed for netns, busybox fallback via umount
-	if ! ip netns del daens 2>/dev/null; then
-		umount /run/netns/daens 2>/dev/null
-		rm -f /run/netns/daens
-	fi
-	# clean orphaned dae0
-	ip link del dae0 2>/dev/null || true
+	:
 }
 
 service_triggers() {

diff --git a/luci-app-daede/root/usr/share/luci-app-daede/update-pkg.sh b/luci-app-daede/root/usr/share/luci-app-daede/update-pkg.sh
index 1c0e47a..48a927d 100755
--- a/luci-app-daede/root/usr/share/luci-app-daede/update-pkg.sh
+++ b/luci-app-daede/root/usr/share/luci-app-daede/update-pkg.sh
@@ -1,132 +1,5 @@
 #!/bin/sh
-# update-pkg.sh <dae|daed|luci-app-daede>
-# Refresh package indexes and upgrade the named package via apk (25.12+) or
-# opkg (24.10). Forks the work to background so the LuCI RPC call returns
-# immediately; the result is streamed to /tmp/luci-app-daede.pkg.<name>.log.
-
-PKG="$1"
-case "$PKG" in
-	dae|daed|luci-app-daede) ;;
-	*)
-		echo "usage: $0 <dae|daed|luci-app-daede>" >&2
-		exit 64
-		;;
-esac
-
-# run from a /tmp copy so upgrading luci-app-daede (which replaces this script)
-# can't corrupt the in-flight upgrade
-case "$0" in
-	/tmp/.daede-upd-*) ;;
-	*)
-		_self="/tmp/.daede-upd-$$"
-		cp "$0" "$_self" 2>/dev/null && exec sh "$_self" "$@"
-		;;
-esac
-
-LOCK="/tmp/luci-app-daede.pkg-${PKG}.lock"
-LOG="/tmp/luci-app-daede.pkg-${PKG}.log"
-
-if [ -f "$LOCK" ]; then
-	mtime=$(date -r "$LOCK" +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
-	age=$(( $(date +%s) - mtime ))
-	if [ "$age" -lt 300 ]; then
-		echo "${PKG} update already in progress (PID $(cat "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null), age ${age}s)" >&2
-		exit 75
-	fi
-	rm -f "$LOCK"
-fi
-
-if ! ( set -C; echo "$$" >"$LOCK" ) 2>/dev/null; then
-	echo "${PKG} update already in progress" >&2
-	exit 75
-fi
-
-(
-	exec >"$LOG" 2>&1
-	trap 'rm -f "$LOCK"; [ "${0#/tmp/.daede-upd-}" != "$0" ] && rm -f "$0"' EXIT INT TERM
-
-	echo "$(date '+%F %T') begin upgrade: $PKG"
-
-	if command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-		# shared apk lock with the bg index refresh (avoid "Unable to lock database")
-		(
-			flock 9 || exit 1
-			if ! apk info -e "$PKG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-				echo "result: $PKG 未通过包管理器安装，不能在线升级"
-				exit 1
-			fi
-			if ! apk update 2>&1; then
-				echo "result: 软件源刷新失败，请检查网络和软件源配置"
-				exit 1
-			fi
-			ver=$(apk list -a "$PKG" 2>/dev/null | awk -v p="$PKG" '$1 ~ "^" p "-[0-9]" { v=$1; sub("^" p "-", "", v); print v }' | sort -V | tail -1)
-			if [ -n "$ver" ]; then
-				constraint="$PKG=$ver"
-			else
-				echo "result: 软件源中没有找到 $PKG，请检查网络或软件源配置"
-				exit 1
-			fi
-			installed=$(apk list -I "$PKG" 2>/dev/null | awk -v p="$PKG" '$1 ~ "^" p "-[0-9]" { v=$1; sub("^" p "-", "", v); print v; exit }')
-			if [ -n "$installed" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$ver" "$installed" | sort -V | tail -1)" = "$installed" ]; then
-				echo "result: $PKG 已安装版本不低于软件源版本，无需升级"
-				exit 2
-			fi
-
-			echo "--- apk add -s $constraint ---"
-			if ! apk add -s "$constraint" 2>&1; then
-				echo "note: apk 预检失败，通常是系统上其它软件包的问题，继续尝试升级"
-			fi
-			echo "--- apk add $constraint ---"
-			apk add "$constraint" 2>&1
-			add_rc=$?
-			[ "$add_rc" -eq 0 ] || exit 1
-			if ! apk list -I "$PKG" 2>/dev/null | awk -v p="$PKG" -v v="$ver" '$1 == p "-" v { found = 1 } END { exit !found }'; then
-				echo "result: $PKG was not upgraded to $ver"
-				exit 1
-			fi
-			exit 0
-		) 9>/tmp/luci-app-daede.apk.lock
-		rc=$?
-		if [ "$rc" = 2 ]; then
-			:
-		elif [ "$rc" != 0 ]; then
-			:
-		elif apk list -u 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^${PKG}-"; then
-			echo "result: $PKG still has a pending upgrade"
-			rc=1
-		else
-			echo "result: $PKG is at the latest available version"
-			rc=0
-		fi
-	elif command -v opkg >/dev/null 2>&1; then
-		echo "--- opkg update ---"
-		if opkg update 2>&1; then
-			echo "--- opkg upgrade $PKG ---"
-			opkg upgrade "$PKG" 2>&1
-			rc=$?
-		else
-			echo "result: 软件源刷新失败，请检查网络和软件源配置"
-			rc=1
-		fi
-	else
-		echo "no package manager found"
-		rc=3
-	fi
-
-	if [ "$rc" = 0 ]; then
-		echo "$(date '+%F %T') ✓ 完成"
-	elif [ "$rc" = 2 ]; then
-		echo "$(date '+%F %T') ✓ 无需升级"
-	else
-		echo "$(date '+%F %T') ✗ 失败 (rc=$rc)"
-	fi
-
-	# luci-app-daede upgrade replaces ACL JSON — reload rpcd so changes apply.
-	if [ "$PKG" = "luci-app-daede" ] && [ "$rc" = "0" ]; then
-		echo "reloading rpcd to pick up new ACL"
-		/etc/init.d/rpcd reload 2>&1
-	fi
-) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
-
-echo "started in background, see $LOG"
-exit 0

+# RC01 source policy: replace core/UI through a reviewed firmware build.
+echo 'RC01: online core/UI upgrades are disabled; rebuild the pinned firmware.' >&2
+exit 1
